content.title: Rooftop Disarm Escape | Approach, Tool Handoff and Threshold Exit
content.summary: An adult broadcast engineer disarms one pursuer and reaches a rooftop service door. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original lead and one exit persist. + The pursuer commits before the single disarm. + Physical conflict remains bounded and non-graphic. + The acquired tool changes access rather than becoming spectacle for its own sake. + The final closed threshold proves escape.
quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult broadcast engineer shelters beside an air unit as one armored security actor crosses the roof. She redirects his wrist, takes one prop launcher and leaves him seated but uninjured. She reaches the service door, enters once and pulls it shut as lights sweep across the empty roof.
